svg.title: TOPAK I9 — ConfinementRefinement.tla: the reference's own confinement states, mapped onto Confinement_A1.tla and held to four of its invariants at every recorded step. Checked by trace validation: 82 traces, 1,007 steps, every one matching
svg.desc: The first stage of ADR-0045's refinement chain (T-0045-28) for confinement, drawn from the module's own text and the trace validation that runs it, all read at build time: the mapping from Mechanism.tla's state onto the abstract module's, the four invariants beside the abstract ones they stand for, what is not checkable here, and the run, trace by trace. A trace validation is a test of recorded behaviours, not a proof: it shows that the reference's recorded states keep these invariants, not that every state it could reach does. The module has no TLC run and no proof of its own.

Key. ① to ③ are what trace2tla.py writes for each trace (read at build time); ④ each state the replay reaches. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the generator and the definitions below.

text.tspan: 's variables, as this module reads them in the reference's state (the module's header)
What the header says it does not check

svg.text: Declared is per seat in the reference (PROVISIONAL declared-rung), so NoSilentDowngrade is read per seat. ContainedMeansConfined is not checkable here: it is about the image the host actually ran, which the mechanism never sees. What is checked in its
place is that contained names only live leases at rung >= 1 on an Attested appraisal of a registered profile: the premises the abstract module's Contained rests on.

text.tspan: The four invariants, each beside the abstract definition it stands for

g.text: NoSilentDowngrade (ADR-0034 §3.4, ADR-0031 A1): no live lease below, or above, its seat's rung.
NoSilentDowngrade (Confinement_A1.tla, line 289): NoSilentDowngrade == \A p \in Principals : lease[p].live => lease[p].rung = Declared
ContestedStopped (ADR-0034 §3.7): a Contested principal is revoked and holds no live lease.
ContestedStopped (Confinement_A1.tla, line 292): ContestedStopped == \A p \in contested : p \in revoked /\ ~lease[p].live
FreshAppraisal (ADR-0034 §3.6): no live lease rests on an appraisal from a fenced epoch.
FreshAppraisal (Confinement_A1.tla, line 295): FreshAppraisal == \A p \in Principals : lease[p].live => lease[p].nEpoch = lease[p].epoch
Contained's premises (ADR-0034 §4): a live lease, rung >= 1, Attested, a registered profile.
Contained (Confinement_A1.tla, line 211): Contained(p) == /\ lease[p].live /\ lease[p].rung >= 1 /\ (Mut = "M_PROFILE" \/ lease[p].prof = Arch)

svg.text: ConfinementRefined is their conjunction (checked at build time). RContainedAttested is not ContainedMeansConfined: that is "about the image the host actually ran, which the mechanism never sees", so its premises are checked in its place (the header). The machine is Mechanism.tla's, which this module extends.
Reference: mechanism/ at 9c57221 + working tree · recorder: crates/topak-core/src/trace.rs · converter: trace2tla.py · driver: mechanism-trace-run.sh
Suites: topak-core tests/mutations.rs, tests/confinement.rs, tests/operators.rs and tests/emergency.rs (every state the helpers build) · topak-node tests/e2e.rs and
tests/contain.rs (replica 1 of every cluster; contain.rs launches the demo guest, rung 3 SIMULATED)
Model: Mechanism.tla (e29dbaf0936dbae1, the digest the file cites)
"A MATCH line means every recorded step's projected state and result equal the model's. A trace is one test; steps are applied log entries."
With the runner (mechanism-trace-run.sh), a line also fails as REFINEMENT … violated when a state breaks ConfinementRefined: every MATCH below includes it.

Every trace, as the file lists it. G10 cites the file (3b1ad26dfd432d48): "82 traces, 1,007 steps, every step matching, and every state keeping ConfinementRefinement.tla's invariants". The file cites Mechanism.tla's digest and not this module's: the build checks that this module has not changed since the file was committed (git, at the pin), which shows order only.
The admit path: decide, then order, then effect
The trusted base: a component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued
Theorem to premise: what every checked or proved property rests on, and what is void at the reference
Verification map: what is checked, what is proved, what must fail, and what neither claims

The corpus's specifications form a graph: layers are open, every edge is typed by what it leaves to a person, a guarantee carries its givens, and a theorem is inherited at the grade of its weakest edge
